# Cloud End Forest

> Cloud End Forest is a private Himalayan forest estate on the western edge of Mussoorie, Uttarakhand, India. It is a private family estate, not a hotel or resort.

## History

Cloud End is one of the oldest estates in Mussoorie. The original bungalow was built in the early colonial era by a British officer, Major Swetenham, who named it "Cloud End" after a peak near his family home in Wales. For generations it remained with the Swetenham family.

After Independence, Cloud End became one of the first of Mussoorie's great estates to pass into Indian ownership, acquired by the late Shri Durga Ram (D.R.) Agarwal, the first Indian owner of this private forest. The estate later passed to his son, Diwaker Agarwal.

## Ownership

Cloud End Forest is a private family estate owned by Diwaker Agarwal. It is distinct from Cloud End Forest Resort, which is a separate business.

## Location

Cloud End, Hathipaon area, Mussoorie, Uttarakhand 248179, India.
